Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust diademed right. Obverse inscription: [--]INV[--]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: GLORI AEXRCITVS. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin, which is heavily encrusted on its obverse side.
